availableDecisions.description: Authoritative list of decisions the client may offer. Render exactly these; never hard-code accept/decline.

command.description: Command awaiting approval (commandExecution only). Summary only; never full env/secrets.

networkApprovalContext.description: Present only when this is a controlled-network-access approval; render host/protocol separately, never as a plain command.

permissions.description: Permissions kind only: one-line summaries of the requested grants (paths/hosts).

reason.description: Why the request was cleared without a user decision (e.g. turn ended, disconnected, expired).

requestId.description: Client-generated unique id per side-effecting command; the server dedupes replays of the same requestId.

seq.description: Server-assigned global monotonic sequence number (companion-implemented; the app-server protocol itself has no global seq).

description: Companion server <-> mobile client protocol. Event names are mapped from the real codex app-server shapes verified in Phase 0 (docs/codex-capability-matrix.md §4/§6); no invented event names.
